High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher Dark Side card back (the back shared by every Dark Side card), shown on [[Dark Side]] (Decipher card back, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Miscellaneous/Card Backs/Dark.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeSllyREJYRUlCWVE/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Dark.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,337,676 bytes, SHA-256 <code>c69fd51841c107f4b167944a7e9d240856c8a430f13758be92414cb7e0eebaca</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

{{HiRez scan note}}

The no-text print-and-play back on [[Dark Side]] stays [[:File:Card-Back-Dark-Side.png]]; this file is the scanned retail back.

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
